lexical.anchor: Until now we have treated a knowledge state roughly as a subset K_t subseteq K. But that is not rich enough ... It cannot naturally express: new dimensions appearing, dimensions disappearing, the value/quality of each dimension changing, and the fact that the dimensional structure itself evolves with time. We need an evolving, potentially infinite-dimensional knowledge space.
